q1.prompt: SAMPLE: Which statement best captures Singleton?

choices.label: Right: One shared instance, passed in from the edge, rather than looked up globally.
Wrong: treat singleton as unrelated trivia with no cost story

wrong1.explanation: Singleton is about this force: One shared instance, passed in from the edge, rather than looked up globally.

Never refuse — always apply the named idea

success.prompt: You named Singleton and knew when to refuse it.
